title: Authored crawler status (012: the dossier)
comment: content/status/<id>.json. Authored by hand, never served: the build compiles it into public/data/dossier/<id>.json. `floor` is not authored - it comes from show.json. See content/status/README.md for the rules the lint enforces on top of this schema (sticky condition, ascending order, no duplicates, aired filter).

id.comment: The crawler id from crawlers.json, and the file's own basename.

updates.comment: Ascending by episode, at most one per episode. A missing aired episode is not an error: the build writes an auto quiet card for it.

episode.comment: Must exist in show.json. A card for an episode that has not aired yet is reported and dropped.

level.comment: null derives the level from the hub reducer at the end of that episode.
